cv.name: Joshua Lacson
cv.headline: Logistics Coordinator | Ocean & Cross-Border Freight | Customs Documentation
cv.summary: Logistics coordinator with four years in freight forwarding and food distribution around the Port of Vancouver. Handles bookings, customs paperwork and carrier follow-up for import and cross-border shipments.

experience.title: Logistics Coordinator
bullets: Coordinate 60–80 ocean and truck shipments per week for importers of furniture and consumer goods
Prepare customs documentation with brokers under CBSA CARM and track releases
Reduced demurrage charges by 35% by flagging containers at risk of free-time expiry
Update shipment status in CargoWise and keep customers informed of delays

experience.title: Logistics Assistant / Dispatch
bullets: Planned daily delivery routes for a fleet of 12 refrigerated trucks
Handled carrier invoices and proof-of-delivery records

education.degree: Bachelor of Business Administration, Supply Chain Management
